 1000| -   Fixed a bug with the i18n extension that caused the explicit
 1001|     pluralization block to look up the wrong variable.
 1002| -   Fixed a limitation in the lexer that made ``{{ foo.0.0 }}``
 1003|     impossible.
 1004| -   Index based subscribing of variables with a constant value returns
 1005|     an undefined object now instead of raising an index error. This was
 1006|     a bug caused by eager optimizing.
 1007| -   The i18n extension looks up ``foo.ugettext`` now followed by
 1008|     ``foo.gettext`` if an translations object is installed. This makes
 1009|     dealing with custom translations classes easier.
 1010| -   Fixed a confusing behavior with conditional extending. loops were
 1011|     partially executed under some conditions even though they were not
 1012|     part of a visible area.
 1013| -   Added ``sort`` filter that works like ``dictsort`` but for arbitrary
 1014|     sequences.
 1015| -   Fixed a bug with empty statements in macros.
 1016| -   Implemented a bytecode cache system.
 1017| -   The template context is now weakref-able
 1018| -   Inclusions and imports "with context" forward all variables now, not
 1019|     only the initial context.
 1020| -   Added a cycle helper called ``cycler``.
 1021| -   Added a joining helper called ``joiner``.
 1022| -   Added a ``compile_expression`` method to the environment that allows
 1023|     compiling of Jinja expressions into callable Python objects.
